name: Győrsövényház (Hungary)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, yellow, blue, yellow and red in the ratio 3:1:8:1:3, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Győrsövényház: a red and blue shield with white flowers, a heart, crossed arrows and white and red bars.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
